description: This file defines a Category class with properties and methods for serialization and deserialization, representing categories in the application.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A model class representing a category with an optional id and a required name, including factory and toMap methods.

methods.name: Category.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates a Category instance from a Map<String, dynamic>.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Category instance into a Map<String, dynamic>, optionally including the id.
